```{r}
#23/24 Data Cleaning Steps

nba_raw <- read.csv("23_24_Height.csv")
dim(nba_raw)

nba <- nba_raw[, c("PLAYER", "TEAM", "AGE", "HEIGHT", "WEIGHT", "GP", "PTS")]
colSums(is.na(nba))
nba$TEAM <- as.factor(nba$TEAM)
str(nba)

nba$height_cm <- height_to_cm(nba$HEIGHT)
nba$elite     <- nba$PTS >= 25
summary(nba$height_cm)
table(nba$elite)  

elite <- filter_elite(nba, threshold = 25)
nrow(elite)  

save(nba, elite, file = "12_DataSaving.RData")

```

```{r}
#24/25
df <- read.csv("24_25_Height.csv")

df_processed <- df %>%
  separate(HEIGHT, into = c("feet", "inches"), sep = "-",
           convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(HEIGHT_IN = feet * 12 + inches)


total_count <- nrow(df_processed)
short_count <- df_processed %>% filter(HEIGHT_IN < 77) %>% nrow()
percentage  <- (short_count / total_count) * 100

cat("\n=== 2024-2025 NBA Season Height Analysis ===\n")
cat("Total Players in Dataset:        ", total_count, "\n")
cat("Players Shorter than 6'5\":       ", short_count, "\n")
cat("Percentage Shorter than 6'5\":    ", round(percentage, 2), "%\n")


df_plot <- df_processed %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(HEIGHT_IN < 77, "Shorter than 6'5\"", "6'5\" or taller")) %>%
  count(Group) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)
```


```{r}
#25/26 Data Cleaning Steps:
stat_data <- read.csv("25_26.csv")
general_data <- read.csv("25_26_Height.csv")

stat_data$PLAYER <- toupper(trimws(stat_data$PLAYER))
general_data$PLAYER <- toupper(trimws(general_data$PLAYER))

general_data$HT_cm <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(general_data$HEIGHT), "-"), function(x)
  (as.numeric(x[1])*12 + as.numeric(x[2])) * 2.54)

general_data <- general_data[general_data$GP >= 20 & !is.na(general_data$HT_cm),] 
```
